HIDDEN_USERS_SUBTITLE: Their messages disappear without blocking them on Discord.
HIDE_IGNORED_SUBTITLE: Also hides messages from users you ignore on Discord.
HIDE_REPLIES_SUBTITLE: Hides replies to anyone this plugin hides.
SEARCH_USERS: Search or paste a user ID
HIDDEN_KEYWORDS_SUBTITLE: Messages containing any of these disappear. One per line; wrap a line in slashes for a regular expression.
